question: Which offerings are prohibited when worshipping Durgā and the sun-god?
premises: Dūrvā grass is mentioned with negated worship of Durgā.
Bilva leaves are mentioned with the sun-god.
inference: One should not worship Durgā with dūrvā grass nor the sun-god with bilva leaves.
plain_english: One should not worship Durgā with dūrvā grass, nor the sun-god with bilva leaves.
